lines.text: College banned dogs, so he brought a bear.

parts.tts: College banned dogs, so he brought a bear.

lines.text: This is Lord Byron, the poet, at Cambridge, around 1807.

parts.tts: This is Lord Byron, the poet, at Cambridge, around 1807.

lines.text: His college reportedly had a rule: no dogs.

parts.tts: His college reportedly had a rule: no dogs.

lines.text: But the rules said nothing... about bears.

parts.tts: But the rules said nothing... about bears.

lines.text: So he got a tame bear.

parts.tts: So he got a tame bear.

lines.text: He wrote to a friend that it was the finest in the world.

parts.tts: He wrote to a friend that it was the finest in the world.

lines.text: Asked what the bear was for... he said it should sit for a fellowship.
